name: Finance calculator
summary: Loan EMI, SIP, fixed deposit, percent and bill split
author: friday-core
description: Money maths in one skill: loans, investments, deposits, percentages and shared bills. It holds 4 tools and picks the right one from what you ask. EMI calculator: Computes a reducing-balance loan EMI with total interest, total payable and the first months of the schedule, and estimates a SIP (monthly compounding, instalment at the start or end of the month) or a lumpsum at a yearly return you give. An estimate from your numbers: a lender's schedule can differ by a few rupees, and an investment return is never guaranteed. Fixed deposit calculator: Works out what a fixed deposit or any compound-interest saving grows to: maturity amount, interest earned and the effective yearly rate. Understands lakh and crore, months or years, and quarterly (the Indian bank default), monthly, half-yearly, yearly or simple interest. Bill splitter: Splits a restaurant or trip bill between a number of people, adds GST or tax and a tip percentage when you give them, and tells who pays the extra paisa so the total adds up exactly. Reads plain requests like: split 2400 among 4 people with 10% tip. Percentage calculator: Answers percentage questions exactly: X percent of Y, A is what percent of B, change from A to B (increase or decrease), add or take off a percent, a discount (20% off 1500) and markup versus margin from a cost and a selling price. Understands Indian number grouping (1,50,000) and a few Hinglish words (ka, pe, chhoot).
